facts.material: polyimide flexible substrate, copper conductors, gold-plated edge fingers
facts.form: flexible circuit with two attached non-printed connectors

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8534 printed circuits; chapter 85 note defining printed circuits is applied and the attached connectors are treated as connection elements, not active elements
GRI 6: 8534.00.00 other than plastics impregnated rigid, flexible type

rejected_alternatives.reason: printed circuit connectors are separate articles; ruling 964473 concerns connectors alone, not a flex circuit with connectors added
rigid plastic-impregnated base; this is flexible
no switching or control apparatus; no active elements stated

missing_facts: Intended end use or machine (if specially a part of a device, heading could change)
Whether the connectors act as more than simple connection elements
classification.rationale: A flexible circuit of copper tracks on a polyimide base with gold contact fingers and attached connectors is a flexible printed circuit of heading 8534. Ruling 964473 (in force) was checked and distinguishes standalone connectors of 8536.69.40, which are not this good.
